package main
import("context";"encoding/json";"fmt";"log";"net/http";"os";"strconv";"strings";"time";"github.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-sprint/dash";"github.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-sprint/store")
type V map[string]any
type verdict struct{author,result string}
func object(v any)V {if x,ok:=v.(map[string]any);ok{return x};return V{}}
func number(v any)int {switch x:=v.(type){case float64:return int(x);case string:n,_:=strconv.Atoi(x);return n};return 0}
func main(){b,e:=os.ReadFile("/var/tmp/friendG-dash-20261106/live.json");if e!=nil{log.Fatal(e)};var root V;if e=json.Unmarshal(b,&root);e!=nil{log.Fatal(e)};data:=object(root["data"]);tables:=object(data["tables"]);work:=object(tables["work"]);ctx:=context.Background();s:=store.NewFake();ws:=[]store.Write{};fixes:=[]store.Write{}; targets:=map[string]map[string]string{};var first string;var parent string;var parentTier string
for stream,val:=range work {ws=append(ws,store.PutStream{Name:stream});row:=object(val); targets[stream]=map[string]string{}; tiers:=[]string{}; for tier:=range object(row["cost_by_tier"]) {tiers=append(tiers,tier)};for _,state:=range []string{"waiting","ready","working","review","fix","merging","landed"}{for i:=0;i<number(row[state]);i++{id:=fmt.Sprintf("p%06d",len(ws));if parent==""{parent=id;first=stream};tier:="pro";if len(tiers)>0 {tier=tiers[0];tiers=tiers[1:];targets[stream][tier]=id};if parent==id {parentTier=tier};ws=append(ws,store.PutCard{ID:id,Kind:"producer",Tier:tier,Stream:stream});target:=state;if state=="fix"{target="ready";fixes=append(fixes,store.SetCardAttempt{Card:id,Attempt:1})};if target!="waiting"{ws=append(ws,store.SetCardState{Card:id,State:target})}}}}
verdicts:=[]verdict{};for _,side:=range []string{"fleet","friends"}{for name,val:=range object(tables[side]){row:=object(val);for i:=0;i<number(row["ok"]);i++{verdicts=append(verdicts,verdict{name,"ok"})};for i:=0;i<number(row["failed"]);i++{verdicts=append(verdicts,verdict{name,"fix"})}}};vi:=0
for _,side:=range []string{"fleet","friends"}{for name,val:=range object(tables[side]){row:=object(val);kind:="worker";if side=="friends"{kind="kin"};ws=append(ws,store.PutRow{Name:name,Kind:kind,Width:number(row["width"]),Tiers:[]string{"flash","pro","heavy","frontier"}});status,_:=row["status"].(string);if strings.HasPrefix(status,"up")||strings.HasPrefix(status,"held"){ws=append(ws,store.SetRowState{Row:name,State:"up"})};if strings.HasPrefix(status,"held"){ws=append(ws,store.SetRowHeld{Row:name,Held:true})};for _,state:=range []string{"ready","working","done"}{n:=number(row[state]);if state=="working"&&n>number(row["width"]){n=number(row["width"])};for i:=0;i<n;i++{id:=fmt.Sprintf("u%06d",len(ws));cardKind:="work";result:="";author:="";if state=="done" && vi<len(verdicts) {cardKind="read";result=verdicts[vi].result;author=verdicts[vi].author;vi++};ws=append(ws,store.PutCard{ID:id,Kind:cardKind,Tier:parentTier,Stream:first,Of:parent,Holder:name},store.SetCardState{Card:id,State:state},store.SetCardCost{Card:id,Priced:true});if result!="" {ws=append(ws,store.SetCardResult{Card:id,Result:result},store.SetCardAuthor{Card:id,Author:author})}}}}}
for stream, val:=range work {for tier, raw:=range object(object(val)["cost_by_tier"]) {idp:=targets[stream][tier];if idp=="" {continue}; price,_:=strconv.ParseFloat(strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimPrefix(fmt.Sprint(raw),"$"),",",""),64); holder:="";for name:=range object(tables["fleet"]) {holder=name;break};if holder=="" {continue};id:=fmt.Sprintf("cost%06d",len(ws));ws=append(ws,store.PutCard{ID:id,Kind:"work",Tier:tier,Stream:stream,Of:idp,Holder:holder},store.SetCardCost{Card:id,Cost:int64(price*1000000+0.5),Priced:true})}}
for name:=range object(tables["fleet"]) {ws=append(ws,store.PutCard{ID:"visual-unpriced",Kind:"work",Tier:parentTier,Stream:first,Of:parent,Holder:name});break}
r,e:=s.Apply(ctx,store.Op{ID:"seed",Epoch:1,Actor:"test",Kind:"seed",At:time.Now(),Writes:ws});if e!=nil||!r.Accepted{log.Fatalf("seed %v %s",e,r.Reason)};if len(fixes)>0 {r,e=s.Apply(ctx,store.Op{ID:"fixes",Epoch:1,Actor:"test",Kind:"fixes",At:time.Now(),Writes:fixes});if e!=nil||!r.Accepted{log.Fatalf("fixes %v %s",e,r.Reason)}};c,e:=dash.New(ctx,s);if e!=nil{log.Fatal(e)};go c.Run(ctx,s);log.Fatal(http.ListenAndServe("127.0.0.1:18082",dash.Handler(c)))}
